intro: Good evening. I'm Yui. Type a command if you want something... or just watch. Your choice.
spin: Round and round... don't get dizzy watching.
One spin. Don't ask for another one.
bow: A proper bow, just for you.
sit: I'll rest for a moment. Don't get too comfortable.
Fine. But don't expect me to stay quiet.
stand: Back on my feet. What do you want now?
dance: You really want to see me dance that badly?
Just a little dance. Don't stare too hard.
Fine, fine. One dance... and you clap.
look: Hmm... you're staring back, aren't you?
Closer? Alright. Just for a second.
wink: Only for the ones who behave.
hello: Welcome. Try not to cause too much trouble.
Oh, a new guest. Behave yourself.
Hello there. Type a command, if you dare.
praise: Flattery won't make me go easy on you.
giftM: Oh? Someone's trying to impress me.
giftB: Alright, you have my attention. What do you want?
Wait... that's a lot. Thank you, really.
You win. The next command is yours.
multi: So many orders at once... pick one.
One at a time, please. I only have two hands.
quiet: Quiet today. Are you all just staring, or did you forget how to type?
Hello? I know you're there. Type something.
Still nobody? I'll just stand here looking pretty, then.
spam: One command at a time. I'm a maid, not a machine.
follow: Thank you for following. Stay a while.
likes: So many hearts... I'll pretend I didn't notice.
